WHOLE_SCREEN_COHESION.note: The enlarged blurred town backdrop connects the menu to the illustrated world, but the sharp town card and two pale rectangular buttons still read as separate assets layered over it.

ART_UI_INTEGRATION.note: The orange play button fits the town card, while the book and challenge controls below revert to generic cream cards with little visual relationship to the diorama.

TYPOGRAPHY_QUALITY.note: The widely tracked JIBUN CHOICE title feels intentional, but the Japanese labels use a conventional rounded sans treatment without a distinctive game-specific hierarchy.

VISUAL_HIERARCHY.note: The saturated town image, large white headline, and orange circular play button make the adventure entry the first obvious target.

SPACING_RHYTHM.note: The title, subtitle, hero, and lower cards form a tidy vertical stack, although the two lower cards sit very close to the hero while a large unused area remains below.

DEPTH.note: The blurred environmental background, crisp hero image, shadows, and overlapping play button create layers, but the strong rectangular masks keep the foreground feeling menu-like.

ICON_CONSISTENCY.note: The book, sprout, and play symbols share a restrained simple-icon approach, though their stroke weights and the solid play treatment are not fully unified.

MOBILE_COMPOSITION.note: The nearly full-width hero and balanced two-column controls are clearly composed for the narrow viewport rather than merely compressed from desktop.

GAME_PREMIUM_FEEL.note: The polished town illustration looks professional, but the blurred wallpaper and generic rounded menu cards make the surrounding experience resemble an educational web app.

AMATEURISHNESS.note: The excessive backdrop blur, weak disabled-card contrast, generic button construction, and disconnected lower controls make the screen feel partially art-directed rather than fully finished.

WHOLE_SCREEN_COHESION.note: The blurred town colors cover the canvas, but the centered hero and two boxed controls remain a compact menu island floating in a very large empty screen.

ART_UI_INTEGRATION.note: The illustration is contained in a cinematic rounded rectangle while the controls below use conventional form-card styling, so the art still feels dropped into a generic shell.

TYPOGRAPHY_QUALITY.note: The uppercase title has deliberate spacing, but the small subtitle and heavy Japanese button labels do not form a particularly distinctive or game-like type system.

VISUAL_HIERARCHY.note: The bright orange play circle and white adventure title dominate the composition immediately despite the large surrounding canvas.

SPACING_RHYTHM.note: The central stack is internally aligned, but it occupies only the upper-middle portion of the viewport and leaves an overwhelming, visually inactive lower half.

DEPTH.note: Foreground cards separate from the blurred backdrop through shadows and sharpness, but every interactive element remains confined to flat rounded rectangles.

ICON_CONSISTENCY.note: The book and sprout are both minimal line icons and the play symbol is clean, although the solid orange circle belongs to a different visual weight.

MOBILE_COMPOSITION.note: The desktop view implies a responsive system that works better on mobile, but its fixed-width centered stack does not meaningfully use the wider format.

GAME_PREMIUM_FEEL.note: The hero artwork is premium-looking, yet the oversized blurred background, sparse desktop layout, and utility-style cards make the overall screen feel like a polished prototype.

AMATEURISHNESS.note: The huge dead area, indiscriminate full-screen blur, muddy disabled state, and rigid card stack expose the layout as an unfinished web composition.

top_3_concrete_fixes: Turn the hero into the foreground of one continuous scene: remove its obvious standalone-card shadow, extend or bleed the sharp illustration beyond the current rectangular mask, and transition its lower edge into the control area with a gradient or layered terrain-shaped overlap.

Replace the uniformly blurred full-screen wallpaper with a controlled scene-derived background treatment: preserve recognizable large environmental forms near the hero, fade toward the pale page color at the edges and bottom, and reduce the desktop blur so the canvas feels intentional rather than enlarged.

Recompose the desktop stack to occupy the viewport: enlarge the hero and controls proportionally, move the group closer to vertical center, tighten the title-to-hero gap, and constrain the lower empty region with responsive min-height and spacing rules.
requires_human_product_decision: Choose a distinctive Japanese display typeface or custom title treatment that can serve as the game's durable typographic identity.
root_cause: The scene-derived background improves cohesion, but the sharp illustration still sits inside a conventional card above generic menu controls, and the sparse desktop composition reinforces the feeling of assets placed on a web menu rather than one continuous game world.
